dog.description_text: Meet Linda! This lovable girl is looking for a family to call her own. She is incredibly sweet and loves everyone she meets. Linda is also playful, affectionate, and always ready to have fun! We think she will be a wonderful companion and a loving addition to her future family! If this animal is located at our Manhattan Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If they are in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Linda
